def factor_volume_return_liquidity_beta(df):
    """Liquidity fragility: negative rolling beta of returns to volume changes indicates distributional selling pressure."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    log_vol = np.log(df_copy["volume"].clip(lower=1.0))
    vol_change = log_vol.diff()
    window = 20
    cov = ret.rolling(window, min_periods=window).cov(vol_change)
    var_vol = vol_change.rolling(window, min_periods=window).var(ddof=1)
    beta = cov / var_vol.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = -beta
    factor.name = "factor_volume_return_liquidity_beta"
    return factor
description: Regime breakdown is often preceded by a shift from normal liquidity-demand dynamics to distributional selling: returns become negatively related to volume changes. This factor estimates a rolling 20-day beta of daily returns on log changes in volume and negates it. A more negative beta indicates that rising volume accompanies falling prices, a crash precursor. The mechanism is distinct from simple volume-ratio pressure and provides a novel raw pathway.
